description: This file defines a set of constants, enums, and methods related to the metrics tagging system in the Eclipse Hono project. It provides standardized tags and categories for metrics collection, such as endpoint types, component types, processing outcomes, TTD statuses, QoS levels, message directions, and utility methods for creating tag sets for services and protocol adapters.

classes.name: MetricsTags
classes.description: Defines various enums and static methods for creating and managing metric tags used throughout the system.

classes.name: MetricsTags.EndpointType
classes.description: Represents different endpoint types (TELEMETRY, EVENT, COMMAND, COMMAND_RESPONSE, UNKNOWN) with associated tag handling logic.

classes.name: MetricsTags.ComponentType
classes.description: Categorizes components as SERVICE or ADAPTER, providing tags for metrics.

classes.name: MetricsTags.ProcessingOutcome
classes.description: Indicates the result of message processing (FORWARDED, UNDELIVERABLE, UNPROCESSABLE) with tagging support.

classes.name: MetricsTags.TtdStatus
classes.description: Represents TTD (Time-To-Deliver) status (NONE, EXPIRED, COMMAND) with tagging support.

classes.name: MetricsTags.QoS
classes.description: Defines the Quality of Service levels with corresponding tags.

classes.name: MetricsTags.Direction
classes.description: Message direction types (ONE_WAY, REQUEST, RESPONSE) with associated tag handling.

methods.name: MetricsTags.forProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Creates default tags for a protocol adapter, including hostname, component type, and component name.

methods.name: MetricsTags.forService
methods.description: Creates default tags for a service, including hostname, component type, and component name.

methods.name: MetricsTags.getTenantTag
methods.description: Generates a tag for a tenant identifier, ensuring the input is non-null.
